derivation: from the base of G4225 (ποτέ) and G5037 (ποτέ);
kjv_def: afore-(any, some-)time(-s), at length (the last), (+ n- )ever, in the old time, in time past, once, when
strongs_def: indefinite adverb, at some time, ever
it_def:
1) una volta, cioè precedentemente, nel passato
2) come avverbio interrogativo: quando?, a che ora?
